title: Forward Deployed Computational Biologist
description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Please submit your CV in English Salary range: $128,000 - $150,000 Ideal start date: January or February 2027 About the role: We are seeking a Forward Deployed Computational Biologist to operate at the intersection of AI, software systems, and biology. In this role, you will work directly with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI solutions for complex scientific problems as part of Owkin’s agentic platform, K Pro, to fully meet specific customer needs. This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will spend time at the customer’s premises, turning ambiguous scientific challenges—such as discovering novel drug targets or disease subtypes—into reliable and scalable agentic solutions. You will be responsible for both the scientific rigor of the analytical workflows and the technical robustness of their implementation and deployment, bridging the gap between science and real-world application. In particular, you will: Deploy & Custom-build : Tailor Owkin’s agentic AI platform, K Pro, to specific client needs by implementing new analytical workflows, and integrate our platform into the clients’ existing workflows. Solve Scientific Problems : Translate complex biological and operational questions into concrete computational workflows, utilizing deep clinical and multi-omics data (genomics, transcriptomics, etc.) and computational biology methodologies. Rapid Prototyping : Iterate quickly with users to validate solutions, balancing speed and quality to ensure effective, measurable impact. Collaboration : Work alongside Customer Success Managers, R&D data scientists, biologists, and software engineers to ensure the delivery of high-quality scientific insights. Knowledge Transfer : Communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders—from clinicians and biologists to technical engineering teams—to ensure alignment and adoption. Participation in a team-wide on-call rotation is required. This role requires frequent international travel to support our global operations and client needs. Anticipated destinations include the Owkin Paris office as well as various client premises across the UK, US, France, Germany, and Switzerland. To facilitate this travel schedule, the successful candidate must be based in close proximity to a major international airport or major train station . About you Required qualifications / experience: Education : MSc/PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven expertise and impact in analyzing complex data, such as real-world clinical data and multimodal omics (e.g, bulk, spatial/single-cell, proteomics) and high-throughput experimental data. Biological knowledge : Strong knowledge of molecular biology and at least one major therapeutic area (oncology, Immunology & Inflammation, neurology, …). Bias for action : Ability to operate in fast-paced environments, managing ambiguity, and driving progress toward delivery. Engineering Proficiency : Very strong programming skills in Python; ability to both ideate and conduct exploratory analyses and data visualisations to aid interpretation; and write clean, production-grade code. Strong familiarity with coding agents. AI/ML Experience : Familiarity with machine learning concepts (e.g., cross-validation, statistical tests) and frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.). Experience with LLMs and agentic AI frameworks is a plus. Communication : Exceptional ability to translate scientific complexity for non-technical internal and external stakeholders. Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience in a Biotech/Pharma environment and excellent understanding of the different steps and respective needs of the typical Pharma drug discovery pipeline. Demonstrated ability to write production-level code in deployed products. #LI-MD1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability. Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information: Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn. Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @ owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby). The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @ Owkin.com . The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information; Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format. If you think that you have been a victim of fraud, Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address hiring@owkin.com contact the following authorities: [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/ [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

title: AI Biologist - Aging & Longevity
description: Latch builds rigorous scientific benchmarks ( benchmarks.bio ) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows: the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field. We’re seeking an AI Biologist to join our Aging & Longevity team to help accelerate the discoveries AI can make in aging biology. About the Role You will use your scientific expertise to improve the ability of AI agents to reason like expert geroscientists. You will build tasks which evaluate aging-specific analysis capabilities and scientific taste. Your judgment will set the standard AI agents are evaluated against. In this role, you will help accelerate research across the entire aging and longevity ecosystem. You will work as part of a team of scientists and software engineers building benchmarks testing capabilities ranging from basic geroscience research to therapeutic discovery and development, including: Development, application, and interpretation of biomarkers of aging, such as proteomic and epigenetic clocks Design and analysis of experiments related to the Hallmarks of Aging , such as quantification of cellular senescence, identification of stem cell exhaustion, and measurement of genomic instability Integration and analysis of diverse data modalities, such as transcriptomics, proteomics, DNA methylation, functional measurements, health records, and imaging data Use of high-throughput screening data to discover and prioritize candidate anti-aging drug targets Requirements Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in biology, bioinformatics, computational biology, or a related field Contribution to published research in aging biology or an adjacent field (cancer, epigenetics, immunology, etc.), such as a first-author paper, thesis, or independent project. Deep familiarity with AI coding tools An ability to convey your thoughts clearly and precisely; i.e., strong scientific writing skills High agency and initiative Demonstrated track record of using R or Python to analyze scientific data Deep computational or experimental experience: Computational: applying machine learning, data analysis, or statistics to -omics data; methods development; statistical genetics Experimental: hands-on wet-lab experience performing experiments and assays relevant to aging research (e.g., sequencing library prep, studies involving model organisms, senescence assays, flow cytometry, cell or organoid culture, in vivo intervention studies) Strongly Preferred Industry experience in biotech, tech, or a similar field Multiple first-author publications Familiarity with frequently used repositories of scientific data, such as: the UK Biobank, TCGA, GEO, ENCODE, etc. Compensation $140K–$180K OTE (on-target earnings), with no ceiling. Your pay is your OTE times your weekly quota attainment. Hit quota, earn your OTE; double it, earn double. Example: $150K OTE at double quota = $300K. Your first 4 weeks (ramp) are paid at full OTE while you learn our workflows. You’re paid full OTE whenever quota can’t fairly apply: when a new project is starting, the platform goes down, or we pull you onto a special project. Benefits & Employment In the US: full-time W-2 Guaranteed floor (“base salary”) set by your state, paid on the 15th and last day of every month Health, dental, vision: 100% covered for you, 50% for dependents 401(k) (no match) PTO: 15 days to start, more as you’re promoted Outside the US: contractor Paid on performance. We want our team to have stability, so we pay 60% of your monthly OTE up front as an advance, balanced against your earnings in later paychecks. US benefits don’t apply. Growth Two tracks, based on output. Individual contributor: six levels, so up to five promotions, with OTE rising at each one. Management: after your first promotion, you can move into managing a pod or keep growing on the IC track. Location & Work Authorization Location: remote or onsite at our Mission Bay office in San Francisco. Onsite is preferred: working side by side is how we share knowledge and keep our work rigorous. We have a global team, and remote teammates regularly visit the office. Work authorization: we sponsor H-1B (new and transfers), O-1, and TN, and support STEM OPT. Culture @ Latch We practice radical transparency: you’ll know how the company is doing, what’s working, and what isn’t. It’s always us against the problem, never each other. We’re opinionated but respectful of each other’s time, and we think through possible solutions before bringing a problem to anyone. We use AI constantly, so we reward original expert judgment, not AI output passed off as your own. You’ll start on the bench that fits your expertise and can move across teams as you build a track record. Outside of work: company outings most months, team off-sites, and a community that does cycling, soccer, figure skating, boxing, running, martial arts, music, books, and game nights. Interview Process Apply. If your profile matches, we’ll send you a take-home project. Take-home project (HackerRank). We review it as soon as it arrives. Technical interview with a Member of Technical Staff (pod lead). Culture interview with our C-suite. Offer. Background check, once you accept.

title: Manager of Bioinformatics (Oncology Product Development)
description:
Natera is currently seeking a Bioinformatics Manager to join the Bioinformatics team focused on Oncology Product Development. In this role, the individual will manage a team of Bioinformaticians and Data Scientists and provide technical leadership in the design, development and validation of ctDNA-based diagnostic tests. This position requires extensive cross-functional collaboration with biostatistics, molecular biology, software engineering and commercial departments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioinformatics and data science, optimally with experience in the LDT assay development space, and an established record of project and technical leadership.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical leadership for product development projects by representing the bioinformatics team in cross-functional interactions and moving products through the full development process through validation and commercial launch.
  • Lead the effort to optimize workflows, improve tools and pressure test analysis pipelines for diagnostic tests, including the detection of cancer-associated variants and the implementation of evidence-based quality control thresholds.
  • Supervise bioinformatics scientists and data scientists, managing their technical contributions, prioritizing resources, and taking responsibility for their technical and professional development.
  • Provide input on experiment design, analysis and interpretation based on expert understanding of Natera’s technology and relevant mathematical principles.
  • Work at a high level of independence and responsibilities in carrying out assignments.
  • Contribute to our intellectual property portfolio.
  • Set standards for rigorous data analysis and lead the production of high-quality documentation. 

QUALIFICATIONS:

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (bioinformatics, engineering, applied mathematics, statistics, or similar).
  • Minimum of 4-8 years of post-graduate experience in a data science and/or bioinformatics role and 1-3 years of experience as technical lead in diagnostics or a related field
  • Experience moving algorithm-based products through commercialization and launch in a medical or biological application such as diagnostic testing, medical imaging, or biotechnology
  • 1-2 years of management experience leading a technical team with demonstrable evidence of leadership and team management skills.

Desirable, but not required:

  • Prior experience analyzing cancer-associated variant detection data

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience using Python or R for scientific data analysis and visualization.
  • Strong foundation in statistical modeling/machine learning, including probability theory and estimation/classification methods.
  • Experience with analysis of next-generation sequencing data, preferably including algorithm development or optimization.
  • Proven ability to apply mathematical principles to solve real estimation problems and implement practical solutions.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills to independently make sound judgments and find creative solutions to moderately complex problems.
  • Experience leading technical projects, including defining and meeting project milestones, delegating tasks to more junior team members, and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills and the desire to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$154,000—$192,500 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

- FBI Cyber Crime resource page

title: Associate Scientist III, Cardiac Modeling
description: The Opportunity insitro is a physical AI company dedicated to unlocking causal human biology and accelerating the delivery of better medicines to patients. Our unique Virtual Human™ platform identifies novel, high-impact genetic intervention points, which our TherML™ platform translates into therapeutics—whether small molecules, biologics, or oligos. With multiple programs in metabolic disease and neuroscience advancing toward the clinic, and our first IND submission slated for the second half of this year, we are at a pivotal inflection point. We are seeking an Associate Scientist III to join our cardiac disease biology team. In this role, you will support the development and application of iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte (iPSC-CM) models to study the genetic and molecular underpinnings of cardiovascular disease — working at the intersection of human stem cell biology, cardiac physiology, and scalable experimental platforms to generate the datasets that fuel our ML-driven drug discovery efforts. You will design and execute experiments, optimize differentiation workflows, develop functional and scalable functional assays to connect cellular phenotypes to disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets. Based in South San Francisco, this position reports directly to Senior Scientist, Cardiometabolic Disease - Translational Genetics and requires you to be onsite at our South San Francisco office 5 days per week . Responsibilities iPSC-CM Platform & Model Development Differentiation & QC: Support the generation and maintenance of iPSC lines and their differentiation into cardiomyocytes in 2D format (monolayers), implementing rigorous quality control points at each stage of the pipeline and with emphasis on production scalability Genetic Disease Models: Assist in building isogenic iPSC-CM disease models — including patient and CRISPR-edited lines carrying disease-associated variants — and characterizing the cellular model to study cardiovascular pathophysiology Functional Assays & Disease Modeling Functional Readouts: Support the development and optimization of functional assays relevant to cardiovascular disease —contractility, electrophysiology, calcium handling, stress responses, high-content imaging — in formats compatible with high-throughput data acquisition Rigor & Reproducibility: Documentation including writing/reviewing technical procedures and SOPs, presentation of results in team meetings and maintaining laboratory notebook with scientific rigor Cross-functional Partnership Target Identification: Contribute to target identification and validation efforts by connecting cellular phenotypes to human genetic evidence, aligning around the team and company goals to advance drug discovery About You Experience & Qualifications Qualifications and previous experience: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in biology, biochemistry, or related discipline with at least 2 years of relevant experience in the biotech/biopharma industry Cell culture and iPSC-CM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in iPSC culture, cardiac directed differentiation and iPSC-CM model characterization in 2D (monolayer) format. Prior experience in 3D/engineered heart tissue platforms or organoids is a plus Genetic Disease Modeling: Previous experience developing genetic iPSC-CM disease models — patient-derived lines, CRISPR-edited isogenic pairs — to study cardiovascular mechanisms Cardiovascular Biology: Background in cardiomyocyte biology and/or cardiovascular disease is preferred Functional Assays: Experience with functional assays relevant to cardiomyocyte biology (contractility, calcium, electrophysiology, imaging, stress responses). Prior exposure and experience working with high-throughput platforms and/or automated systems is a plus Molecular Assays: Hands-on expertise in molecular assays, such as PCR, RT-qPCR, Western Blot and immunofluorescence Scientific Communication: Track record of executing rigorous experiments and communicating findings clearly in publications, presentations or internal reports Core Competencies Cross-functional and Curious Collaborator: You are comfortable managing multiple tasks efficiently, communicating clearly and effectively, building open and collaborative relationships and are curious about implementing novel ML models into functional biology Independent & Adaptive: You thrive in a fast-paced environment working both independently and as part of a small, dedicated team while staying aligned with the team objectives Scientific Rigor and Attention to Detail : You excel at designing and executing experiments with the utmost scientific rigor, strong attention to detail and a positive and go-getter attitude towards unexpected results and challenges Compensation & Benefits at insitro Our target starting salary for successful US-based applicants for this role is $107,000 - $114,000. To determine starting pay, we consider multiple job-related factors including a candidate's skills, education and experience, market demand, business needs, and internal parity. We may also adjust this range in the future based on market data. This role is eligible for participation in our Annual Performance Bonus Plan (based on company targets by role level and annual company performance) and our Equity Incentive Plan, subject to the terms of those plans and associated policies. In addition, insitro also provides our employees: 401(k) plan with employer matching for contributions Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as mental health and well-being support Open, flexible vacation policy Paid parental leave of at least 16 weeks to support parents who give birth, and 10 weeks for a new parent (inclusive of birth, adoption, fostering, etc) Quarterly budget for books and online courses for self-development New hire stipend for home office setup Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Access to free onsite baristas and daily lunch for employees who are either onsite or hybrid Access to a free commuter bus network that provides transport to and from our South San Francisco HQ from locations all around the Bay Area insitro is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion need to be at the foundation of our culture. We work hard to bring together diverse teams–grounded in a wide range of expertise and life experiences–and work even harder to ensure those teams thrive in inclusive, growth-oriented environments supported by equitable company and team practices. All candidates can expect equitable treatment, respect, and fairness throughout the interview process. #LI-Hybrid Please be aware of recruitment scams: we never request payments, all recruitment communications are from @ insitro.com , and if in doubt, contact us at info@insitro.com . About insitro insitro is a drug discovery and development company using machine learning (ML) and data at scale to decode biology for transformative medicines. At the core of insitro’s approach is the convergence of in-house generated multi-modal cellular data and high-content phenotypic human cohort data. We rely on these data to develop ML-driven, predictive disease models that uncover underlying biologic state and elucidate critical drivers of disease. These powerful models rely on extensive biological and computational infrastructure and allow insitro to advance novel targets and patient biomarkers, design therapeutics and inform clinical strategy. insitro is advancing a wholly owned and partnered pipeline of insights and therapeutics in neuroscience and metabolism. title: Technical Sales Manager - Growth Accounts (US Overlay)
description:
WHO ARE WE

Parse Biosciences, a QIAGEN company, is a global life sciences company whose mission is to accelerate progress in human health and scientific research. Empowering researchers to perform single cell sequencing with unprecedented scale and ease, its pioneering approach has enabled groundbreaking discoveries in cancer treatment, tissue repair, stem cell therapy, kidney and liver disease, brain development, and the immune system.

With technology developed at The University of Washington, Parse has raised over $100 million in capital and is now used by over 3.000 customers across the world. Our growing portfolio of products includes Evercode Whole Transcriptome, Evercode TCR, BCR, Gene Capture, and Trailmaker, our data analysis solution.

Parse Biosciences is based in Seattle, Washington's vibrant South Lake Union district, where we recently opened a 34,000 square foot headquarters and state-of-the-art laboratory.

THE POSITION

As a Technical Sales (Account) Manager, you will be responsible for achieving sales objectives for our single cell RNA sequencing products through the development of new business and management of current customer accounts. You will be expected to create and execute a sales strategy across academic, biotech, and pharmaceutical accounts while working closely with Field Application Scientists and other Parse team members. Candidates should have strong technical skills, sales skills, the ability to develop and manage customer relationships, and a drive to overachieve. Gaining a deep understanding of the single cell market and Parse’s products will be critical to success.  You will accelerate growth in both named Key Accounts and select territories across the United States.  You will act as a specialist to move an emerging segment faster than one rep can on their own.

TERRITORY AND TRAVEL

Key accounts will be defined and open territory focus will change based on business needs.  The position will require travel approximately 50% of the time. 

IN THIS POSITION, YOU WILL

• Generate and manage both high volume and large complex sales.
• Ensure customers are satisfied and making rapid experimental progress.
• Develop, maintain, and grow repeat business while maintaining strong relationships.
• Prospect effectively to generate an immediate, medium, and long-term sales pipelines to ensure consistent quota obtainment.
• Negotiate and close deals while minimizing discounting.
• Effectively communicate technical advantages to customers.
• Develop a quarterly and yearly business plan that incorporates both strategic and tactical activities.
• Prioritize and qualify inbound leads.
• Provide management with insight on competition, market trends, and customer feedback.
• Manage your sales funnel with a high degree of accuracy.
• Leverage expertise of Field Application Scientists to support customers and drive sales.
• Leverage expertise of prospecting specialists to maximize customer meetings and drive new sales.
• Use CRM to manage and track deals.
• Continue to develop technical knowledge related to new, emerging, and related single cell research.
• Forecast projected sales in your territory.
• Display a high degree of professionalism both internally and externally.

FOR THIS POSITION, WE LOOK FOR

• Bachelors in biology/genomics or a related field. A Masters or PhD is a plus.
• Minimum of 1 year of field sales experience in NGS and/or genomics-related products or services, including both account management and new business development..
• Previous molecular biology lab experience is preferred.

About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.

title: AI Biologist - Protein Design & Engineering
description: Latch builds rigorous scientific benchmarks ( benchmarks.bio ) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows: the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field. We're seeking an AI Biologist to join our Protein Design & Engineering team, working at the frontier of what artificial intelligence can achieve in biology. About the Role AI agents can now run the full protein design toolkit: generate backbones, design sequences, predict complexes, score interfaces and propose mutations. The open question is whether they make good decisions with it. We are building benchmarks that test exactly that, from designing a new binder from scratch to improving an existing one toward a measured function. You will work across three connected areas: De novo design. Given a target and a goal, can an agent design, filter and choose candidates that actually work? Tasks test the decisions that separate a real hit from a confident-looking failure: which design tool to trust, which filter to apply, which candidates to send to the lab. Protein–protein interactions. Can an agent reason about a complex correctly? Tasks test whether it finds the true interface and its hotspots, tells a real interface from a crystal contact, reconciles co-folding models that disagree, and predicts how mutations change binding affinity and specificity. Optimization. Given a de novo or redesigned protein, can an agent improve affinity, stability, expression or developability without breaking something else? Every task is graded against real measured data: binder screens, binding affinities, deep mutational scans, combinatorial landscapes, developability panels and published engineering campaigns. Your job is to find the decision point in that data and turn it into a question with one verifiable answer. The work sits under our biosecurity program. You will build tasks on therapeutics such as antibodies, nanobodies, minibinders and enzymes. You will also help test whether agents correctly decline to design or improve pathogen and toxin proteins. specificity against off-targets, and affinity changes on mutation Cover the full workflow: generate, filter, rank, combine, revert, triage pools and trade off competing objectives Set floors (the tool alone, the best single metric, the screen's base hit rate) so an agent has to beat its own tools Judge the agent Read agent reasoning and code step by step, and find where a plausible design choice goes wrong Reward calibrated decisions over confident ones Requirements PhD (or equivalent experience) in protein design, protein engineering, structural biology, biophysics, computational biology or a related field Hands-on design or engineering in the last ~2 years, with experimental validation of your own designs: de novo binders or enzymes, antibody engineering, directed evolution, DMS, library design or ML-guided optimization Working knowledge of protein–protein interfaces: hotspots, shape and charge complementarity, affinity and specificity, and how binding is measured (SPR, BLI, ITC, display screens) Working knowledge of modern design and structure tools such as RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, BindCraft, AlphaFold, Boltz, Chai or ESM, and a clear sense of where each one fails Deep title: AI Biologist - Cell Therapy Discovery

We're seeking an AI Biologist to join our Cell Therapy Discovery team, pushing what AI can achieve therapeutic cell design. The role AI agents can now design cell therapy candidates, plan experimental research, and analyze data from sophisticated studies. But are their decisions grounded in the same rigorous standards upheld by human experts? LatchBio builds benchmarks designed to measure and improve the success of models in performing difficult research challenges. AI Biologists leverage their own hands-on scientific expertise to construct gradable problems for AI based on real-world data. In this role, you will distill your experience in the field into precise questions with verifiable answers that a human expert would get right and even the strongest frontier models might get wrong. What you'll do Build the task Source experimental data from the cell therapy field, ranging from early discovery to clinical correlates. Curate datasets across a wide variety of assays and sources. Set the hard tasks Build tasks around critical scientific questions in cell therapy in which expert judgements are required to make mission critical decisions, including assessments of safety, efficacy, and priority. Cover the full early workflow: design, screen, filter, rank, and advance. Judge the agent Read agent reasoning trajectories and code step-by-step, and find where a plausible design choice goes wrong and what should be done differently Reward justifiable decisions over confident guesses. Understand where there is uncertainty and reward it appropriately. What we're looking for PhD in molecular biology, cancer biology, synthetic biology, bioengineering, or a related field. An MS with equivalent hands-on pipeline experience also qualifies. 2 to 6 years working hands-on with cell therapy or cell engineering, i.e., executing experiments and analyzing primary data. Strong expertise with at least one core capability, for example, phenotypic profiling, potency methods, construct design, in vivo methodologies. This Opportunity 

This Customer Facing Research Analyst position is a high impact, customer-facing role that requires a diverse set of skills spanning technical execution, applied research methodology, and relationship management. You will work directly with life sciences partners to translate research questions into analytical approaches, execute studies using real-world Electronic Health Record (EHR) data (~120M+ patients), and guide customers in best practices for real-world evidence generation.

You will play a key role in advancing customer research by helping shape analytical approaches, ensuring methodological rigor, and driving projects forward from question to insight. While customers may define or co-develop study protocols, you will provide guidance on study design, bias considerations, statistical approaches, and interpretation of results. This role requires balancing rapid-response analytical support with deeper, more complex investigations, while maintaining a high bar for scientific rigor and customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with life sciences customers to understand research questions and translate them into analytical approaches
  • Required to excel in providing technical analytics support as well as directly working with customers on calls to troubleshooting customer analysis.

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, acting as a key partner in advancing their research goals
  • Apply appropriate research methodologies, including cohort design, bias mitigation, and statistical analysis
  • Communicate on the status of various projects and collaborate with success managers to ensure that Truveta clients can be successful with the platform.
  • Guide customers on best practices in real-world data research, including study design tradeoffs and interpretation of results
  • Lead customer-facing discussions to unblock research challenges and drive projects forward
  • Collaborate with customers to support peer-reviewed publications and high-quality research outputs
  • Deliver both rapid-response analyses and deeper, in-depth investigations depending on customer needs
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for customer analyses, code, and notebooks
  • Create enablement materials as the Truveta platform evolves to help onboard new researchers to our increasing capabilities.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to investigate data quality and demonstrate data reliability
  • Deliver feedback to internal teams based on customer requests to inform Truveta’s product roadmap.

Required Skills

  • Undergraduate or graduate degree in clinical research, epidemiology, biostatistics, data science, clinical informatics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience working in a technical customer-facing role, delivering high-quality research studies & analyses.
  • 3+ years of experience wrangling and analyzing Electronic Health Record data or other Real World Data sources in life science companies, CROs, other EHR data companies or healthcare organizations.

  • Experience working across large, multi-domain healthcare datasets with millions of patients and hundreds of millions of records, leveraging distributed computing frameworks for scalable analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience applying research methodologies, including cohort design and statistical approaches.
  • Experience delivering high-quality product demonstrations that enable customers or stakeholders to understand and effectively leverage data, platform capabilities, and analytical workflows.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build credibility and trust across stakeholders and effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

These qualifications are preferred but not required. Candidates will have opportunities to develop these skills over time.

  • Advanced degree (MS, MPH, PhD) in epidemiology, biostatistics, health economics, or related field
  • Experience supporting or contributing to peer-reviewed publications or conference abstracts
  • Knowledge of advanced statistical methods such as regression, propensity score methods, survival analysis, and longitudinal data analysis
  • Experience applying methods for causal inference or handling incomplete data in observational research
  • Experience with Spark/PySpark or distributed data processing
  • Experience with Regression, Propensity Score Matching, Kaplan-Meier Analyses, or Survival Analyses

title: Product Manager, Care Delivery
description:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role: 

Care Delivery is the infrastructure that powers how Maven members access care and how our providers deliver it. Every program we run across maternity, fertility, menopause, and pediatrics, depends on it. It's where clinical workflows, provider tooling, and the systems that make care measurable, billable, and scalable at Maven's scale all come together.

We're looking for a Product Manager to help build that platform: the EHR and clinical tooling, provider workflows, messaging, and the data and billing infrastructure that turn Maven's care model into something reliable and scalable. You'll own defined capabilities within the platform and drive them from problem to shipped, in close partnership with engineering, clinical, design, and operations. It's a high-leverage seat. What you build here touches every program Maven offers.

You'll report to the Group Product Manager, Care Delivery, and work closely with our providers, as well as Clinical Product, Member Experience, Operations, and the Data and AI Platform teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own specific Care Delivery capabilities end-to-end, provider workflows, clinical documentation, messaging, scheduling and matching, or quality and billing infrastructure, from problem definition through launch and iteration.
  • Make crisp, well-reasoned product decisions, especially where clinical accuracy and provider experience are both at stake.
  • Use AI hands-on to move faster, prototyping with AI tools to test ideas and pressure-test flows before committing engineering time, and identify and build AI-powered capabilities into the care delivery platform where they genuinely improve the provider or member experience.
  • Partner daily with engineering and design to ship reliable platform capabilities, and with clinical and operations partners so that what you build works for real providers and members.
  • Translate regulatory and quality requirements, like HEDIS measures and clinical coding, into clean product experiences that add value without adding friction.
  • Instrument what you ship, watch how it performs, and iterate. Bring data to every decision.
  • Build platform primitives, reusable capabilities that serve many programs, rather than one-off features.
  • Bring a point of view on how AI can improve care delivery workflows, and put it to work in how you build.

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 3+ years in product management, ideally with some time in healthcare tech or another complex, regulated, or operations-heavy domain.
  • A strong executor: you take ambiguous problems, break them down, and ship, without needing everything defined for you.
  • Solid data instincts: you define the right metrics, work with real datasets, and communicate findings clearly to both clinical and commercial audiences.
  • Comfort with technical and clinical complexity: you can hold your own in an engineering sprint and a clinical review, and you're eager to learn the domain fast (FHIR, interoperability, EHR workflows).
  • Genuine care for providers and members: the people using what you build show up in your decisions.
  • Clear, direct communication and strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • Fluency with AI and a genuine desire to build with it: you understand how modern AI models work well enough to know where they're reliable and where they aren't, you reach for AI tools to prototype and think, and you're excited to ship AI-powered features rather than just talk about them.
  • Bonus: experience with EHR or EMR systems, clinical workflows, healthcare interoperability, or provider-facing tools.

The base salary range for this role is 155,000-185,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY.

Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

title: Partner Development Manager, AI Partnerships
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Worldwide Alliances and Channels team develops and manages partnerships that help businesses adopt Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure. These partnerships create new routes to customers, extend the reach of Stripe’s Sales teams, and help Stripe and its partners serve shared customers.

The role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team. The team builds and executes joint go-to-market initiatives with major technology companies, with the goal of accelerating Stripe’s commercial growth.

As part of this team, you’ll lead global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, with an initial emphasis on leading AI labs. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, and regional partnerships teams to develop shared opportunities and turn them into scalable global partner strategies.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Development Manager, you’ll define and build Stripe’s global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, initially focusing on leading AI labs. Although the role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team, its mandate is global. You’ll establish relationships across partner organizations, develop shared value propositions, and translate early opportunities into joint commercial and product initiatives.

This is an opportunity to build a new partnership motion from the ground up. You’ll start with focused opportunities, determine what works, and create a playbook that Stripe’s regional teams can apply around the world. Your work will span co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building.

Responsibilities

  • Build senior relationships across the commercial, partnerships, product, and technical organizations of Stripe’s priority AI partners
  • Develop and execute global partner strategies, including shared value propositions, joint business plans, success measures, and operating cadences
  • Identify and launch co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building initiatives that create value for Stripe, its partners, and shared customers
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, Legal, Finance, and regional partnerships
  • Work with Product and technical teams to identify opportunities for product collaboration and support productive technical conversations with partners
  • Create repeatable partnership playbooks that regional teams can adapt for local markets and AI ecosystems
  • Assess partnership performance, identify opportunities and risks, and communicate progress clearly to senior stakeholders

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8 or more years of experience in strategic partnerships, partner development, business development, or a related commercial role within technology or another complex business-to-business environment
  • Experience building a strategic technology partnership from its early stages and translating the relationship into joint commercial, go-to-market, or product outcomes
  • Experience developing and executing joint go-to-market plans with external partners and cross-functional Sales, Marketing, Product, or technical teams
  • Experience building relationships with senior external stakeholders and leading global or distributed teams through influence
  • Bachelor’s degree and willingness to travel

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience managing partnerships with artificial intelligence companies, cloud providers, data platforms, developer platforms, or other global technology ecosystems
  • Understanding of the artificial intelligence and data value chain, including the commercial and technical considerations involved in building partner ecosystems
  • Experience across co-selling, co-marketing, and product or technical collaboration
  • Experience developing a partnership framework or playbook that was adopted across multiple regions or teams
  • Experience in payments, financial infrastructure, financial services, or commerce

Dig into data to find surprising trends about startups, technology, founders, and what people are building. Take complicated technical subjects and make them clear, accurate, and interesting. Experiment with new editorial formats and ways of telling stories. There isn't one obvious background for this role. You might be an engineer who loves writing, someone from developer relations, a technical journalist, a data journalist, a researcher, a former founder, or someone who has worked at a think tank. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. Our Account Manager team works alongside our Professional Services, Product, Sales and technical teams to help our most strategic customers enhance the value of their Benchling investments. Account Managers will engage regularly and strategize directly with our customers to ensure long term value. Alongside the client, they will develop strategies and tactics to understand the health of the client, own renewal negotiations and execution and drive expansion of success packages. Through regular engagements with the clients, Account Managers will identify clients who can benefit from a product or technical subject matter expert related to areas of improvement, and direct them to the approapriate team to drive progress on customer initiatives. Experience negotiating upwards of $100,000 in ARR for renewals and expansions in collaboration with sales to drive accurate forecasting around adoption, expansion and retention. description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Associate Delivery Manager to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

At ROOM42, 21GRAMS' in-house Content Studio and production company, we are seeking an Associate Delivery Manager to support the successful delivery of creative work across our global studio network. Reporting to a Delivery Manager, this is an early-career opportunity for an ambitious individual looking to build a career in creative operations, project delivery and studio management. The Associate Delivery Manager supports the day-to-day coordination of projects across the Content Studio, ensuring work progresses efficiently through the studio, timelines are maintained, and stakeholders remain informed. Working closely with Delivery Managers, Senior Delivery Managers, Creative teams and Project Managers, this role provides a strong foundation in creative delivery, resource coordination and operational excellence.

This position is ideal for someone with 1-3 years of experience in project coordination, production, account management, creative operations or a related agency environment who is looking to develop into a future Delivery Manager.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

Project Coordination & Delivery Support

  • Support the day-to-day coordination of projects across the Content Studio.
  • Maintain project schedules, task assignments and status updates within Workfront and associated delivery tools.
  • Help ensure projects progress through the studio on time and according to agreed deadlines.
  • Track project milestones and proactively highlight risks or delays to the Delivery Manager.
  • Support project teams by coordinating meetings, status updates and project documentation.

Workflow & Triage

  • Assist with intake management and project triage processes.
  • Route incoming requests to the appropriate creative teams under the guidance of the Delivery Manager.
  • Monitor project queues and help ensure work is prioritized appropriately.• Develop an understanding of ROOM42 disciplines including Print, Presentations, Design,

Social, Motion Graphics, Digital & Technology, and Editorial & Submissions.

  • Help identify workflow bottlenecks and escalate concerns quickly.

  • Support resource scheduling across studio teams.
  • Maintain accurate workload and allocation information within planning tools.
  • Help balance priorities across multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Escalate capacity conflicts or resourcing concerns to the Delivery Manager.
  • Build an understanding of global delivery models including onshore, nearshore and offshore teams.

Operational Excellence

  • Support adherence to established delivery processes, governance and best practices.
  • Ensure project records, timelines and reporting remain accurate and up to date.
  • Champion disciplined use of Workfront and delivery tools.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Content Studio.
  • Learn and adopt AI-enabled tools and workflows that improve efficiency and quality.

Partnership & Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships with Creative, Project Management and Account teams.
  • Support effective communication across project stakeholders.
  • Help remove operational blockers and maintain project momentum.
  • Demonstrate a proactive, solutions-focused approach to challenges.
  • Represent ROOM42's collaborative and client-focused culture in all interactions.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in Project Coordination, Project Management, Creative Operations,

Production, Account Management or a related agency environment.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Understanding of creative, production or project delivery workflows.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working with project management tools and technology platforms.• Eagerness to learn commercial, operational and resource management fundamentals.
  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic and a willingness to grow within the Delivery Management function.
  • Takes ownership of day-to-day project coordination activities.
  • Maintains accurate project data, schedules and reporting.
  • Builds strong relationships with creative and operational stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of ROOM42 workflows and disciplines.
  • Anticipates delivery challenges and escalates risks appropriately.
  • Contributes to a positive, organized and efficient studio environment.
  • Continuously develops delivery, commercial and operational knowledge.
  • Progresses toward readiness for promotion into a Delivery Manager role.

Career Path: Associate Delivery Manager → Delivery Manager → Senior Delivery Manager → Associate Director, Delivery Management

This role serves as the primary development pathway into Delivery Management, providing hands-on exposure to project delivery, workflow management, resource coordination and studio operations within a global content production environment.

Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? About us

Retail Insights is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.

Retail Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. 

What we offer you

As our Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.

  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Retail Insights is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.

Retail Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. 

What we offer you

As our B2B Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person

description: Hi 👋 I’m Dom Allgood, Client Education Manager at hyperexponential. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. Real Chemistry is looking for a Project Manager to join our growing Medical Affairs team!  

The Project Manager is responsible for delivering assigned medical affairs projects from initiation through final closeout, including planning, coordination, budget management, routing, approvals, and launch of project deliverables. Projects may include slide decks, print projects, congress materials, advisory board materials, scientific communications, and smaller digital initiatives. This role serves as a main point of contact across internal and external teams, partnering closely with Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, User Experience, Technology, and Quality Assurance partners to keep work on time, on budget, and aligned to client expectations.

Associate Medical Writer

Inizio Medical – allegro.WRITE

Locations: Manchester, Macclesfield, Glasgow, London

Start Date: Feb 2027

 

Medical communications: entry-level training programme – allegro.WRITE

What is allegro.WRITE?

Are you a first-class communicator who is passionate about improving the lives of patients through scientific communications? Do you want a challenging, yet rewarding career at the forefront of the healthcare industry working on cutting-edge science? If so, medical writing might be the career for you ….

We’re looking for high calibre, enthusiastic and motivated aspiring writers to join Inizio Medical through our multi-award-winning training and development programme, allegro.WRITE.

 

allegro.WRITE is a comprehensive, year-long programme, designed to equip you for a role as a Medical Writer with Inizio Medical – a company including three of the world-leading medical communications agencies: ApotheCom, Ashfield MedComms and Nucleus Global. Successful candidates join our business as an Associate Medical Writer, on a full-time contract. The programme comprises an initial, dedicated training phase, followed by a team placement within the business to gain varied, real-life med comms experience. You will join energetic and passionate teams, building your confidence and ability by working alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. After 12 months, you will leave allegro.WRITE as a fully-fledged Medical Writer and become an integral part of an account team at one of our agencies, delivering contemporary, multichannel medical communications solutions to our clients!

What do I need?

To be considered for the role you must have a minimum of a 2:1 in a Life Sciences degree. No previous writing experience is necessary, but good written and verbal communication skills, an awareness of the pharmaceutical industry, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for knowledge are important! You must have a full right to work in the UK and be available for training across July and August.

What’s the recruitment process?

To apply, please send us your CV, together with a biography of ≤500 words, highlighting your skills, interests and relevant experience. Please combine your CV and biography in one document.

Suitable candidates will be asked to take a formal writing test, followed by the final stages of the process, which will be scheduled for December. The job commences in February 2027 and will run from our Manchester, Macclesfield, London and Glasgow offices.

What are the benefits of joining Inizio Medical?

As one of our writers, you’ll benefit from a defined career path, diverse project work, competitive salary and benefits, and opportunities to travel the world!

As part of allegro.WRITE, you will have tailored and dedicated training, coaching and mentoring, alongside ‘on the job’ experience with nurturing teams. As you progress in your career, you will also have the option to join our allegro.EXCEL programme, supporting you in your development to senior scientific leadership roles at Inizio Medical!

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. About the team

You'll be joining the Finance Operational Excellence team, reporting to the Head of Finance Operational Excellence. We are finance transformation and AI experts working side-by-side with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to redefine processes and build the finance organization of the future. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across disciplines: part solution developer, part data architect, part workflow designer, and part coach. What you’ll do

You'll work side-by-side with Finance subject matter experts to understand how work gets done, identify the highest impact opportunities, and partner with domain teams to chart a transformation plan which balances future ambitions with rapid impact.  You'll work independently to automate manual processes, design and build agents and required data solutions using internal platforms, and enable Finance teams to maintain these solutions long-term. 

You’ll build with your partner teams, not simply deliver solutions to them. You’ll help colleagues move from a manual workflow, to a first AI-enabled win, to a reliable solution they can confidently operate and improve themselves. Success means the workflow stays transformed after the initial build, the team trusts the output, and the people closest to the process can own what comes next. 

You’ll favor learning through building. When possible, you’ll put a useful prototype in front of a Finance user, test it against a real deliverable, and improve it quickly rather than spend weeks describing a theoretical future state. When you encounter platform limitations—which you will—you’ll find creative, supportable approaches, collaborate with Engineering to scope and test custom tools, and escalate strategically when needed.

This role requires a blend of process automation, data operations, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder enablement. You'll spend your time building agents, optimizing data pipelines that feed them, creating knowledge layers that make them more accurate, and training Finance teams to use and maintain them. Success means Finance teams can independently run agents you've built while you provide light support and focus on the next automation opportunity.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • Working knowledge of development practices such as version control, testing, code review, and iterative delivery.
  • Experience using low-code tools, scripting, workflow automation, AI-assisted development, or custom integrations, paired with curiosity and the ability to learn evolving technologies.

You will also likely have (not required):

  • Domain experience in Finance Operations, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Payments, or other areas.
  • Familiarity with modern data tools and practices, such as Python, Databricks, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data-quality controls.

Note on technical depth: This role involves working at the intersection of no-code AI tools and custom development. The team also engages with external parties and organizations in publication ethics-related discussions and initiatives.

You will also support PLOS journal editors in their publication ethics work, contribute to Publication Ethics team projects and initiatives (e.g. efforts to improve detection and/or resolution of publication ethics issues), and contribute to other team-level efforts to address ethics and integrity issues at PLOS.

You will report to a Senior Editor, Team Manager for the PLOS Publication Ethics team.

  • Resolve publication ethics cases efficiently and in line with PLOS standards and COPE guidance; prevent reputational damage to PLOS journals as feasible.
  • Contribute to triage of incoming publication ethics cases
  • With other Publication Ethics team members, develop workflow and policy updates as needed to optimize detection and/or handling of publication ethics issues.
  • Support journal editors in resolving publication ethics issues that arise during manuscript handling, peer review, or post-publication.
  • Communicate rapidly and effectively about ethics cases with involved/affected stakeholders, including the journal’s editorial leads, Editorial Board members, authors, members of other PLOS teams, and any other parties involved in publication ethics case work.
  • Contribute to internal discussions about publication ethics, research integrity, and related issues in team-level and interdepartmental/cross-team forums.

  • Uphold high standards of professionalism in all internal and external communications about publication ethics issues.

The Opportunity at Komodo Health

This role performs configuration tasks to meet Komodo Health customer requirements, working closely with the Solution Architect. They are the experts on configuration and collaborate with the project team and our clients.

This person is part of the Configuration Team, working closely with the Solution Architects to design and build out the configuration creatively and efficiently to meet the requirements. They will also work closely with the Business Analyst during the test writing phase and with the testing team during test execution to provide expertise and guidance.

Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have…

  • Participate in client-facing design reviews, working sessions, and training to demo and illustrate solutions.
  • Collaborate with other project team members to gain efficiencies and help implement best practices for project delivery and knowledge transfer.

You will accomplish these outcomes through the following responsibilities…

  • Document and implement configuration changes and data-mapping requirements (10%)
  • Review requirements and ensure solutions meet the requirements (10%)

What you bring to Komodo Health:

  • Ability to effectively design scalable solutions to meet client business needs and perform system configuration
